name: HANA Cloud Multitenancy API
description: SAP HANA Cloud Tenant Management Service provides APIs to manage tenants, containers, and credentials

info.title: Tenant Management Service
info.description: SAP HANA Cloud Tenant Management Service provides a set of APIs to manage tenants in SAP HANA Cloud. The APIs allow you to create, update, delete, and list tenants, containers, and credentials. The APIs also allow you to run operations on tenants.

externalDocs.description: SAP HANA Cloud Tenant Management Service API

spec.x-sap-shortText: APIs to manage SAP HANA Cloud Multi-Tenancy

servers.description: SAP HANA Cloud Tenant Management Service Service REST API endpoint

get.description: Collection API to list tenant instances. This api supports eventual consistency, which means that changes of tenants may be delayed from being updated to the list.  It may contain stale values. For strong consistency, the Get tenant API that returns a single tenant must be used.

parameters.name: serviceInstanceID
parameters.description: Lists the status of tenant instances associated with the given HANA service instance ID

parameters.name: $skiptoken
parameters.description: A continuous token used to retrieve the next page.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: A maximum number of tenants returned in the response. By default it returns up to 1,000 tenants. Returned tenants might be equal to 1,000 or fewer than 1,000 but it'll never contain more

parameters.name: $count
parameters.description: The decision whether to include the tenant number in the response

$skiptoken.description: A tenant name where you want to start listing from

post.description: Creates a new tenant instance with HANA service instance id. Users can create multiple tenants in parallel by sending multiple requests at the same time, but the parallel acceptable requests are limited around 10 requests. URL of the tenant instance being created will be returned via HTTP header `Location`, and users can check the status of creation request by calling `GET {Location}`. `serviceInstanceID` in the request body must be a valid HANA service instance id that already exists. Otherwise, the API will return HTTP status code `400 Bad Request`.

Location.description: The URL of the created tenant

parameters.name: tenantID
parameters.description: Tenant ID

get.description: Gets the tenant and its status. An HTTP header `ETag` is returned to support optimistic concurrency control.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag value from a previous GET response. If matches the current resource version, returns 304.

ETag.description: Entity tag for optimistic concurrency control

put.description: If a tenant with the given tenant id already exists under the given HANA service instance, updates the existing one with given data in the request body. If no tenant with the tenant id exists, creates a new tenant instance with the given tenant id and HANA service instance id. If a tenant with the tenant id already exists under another HANA service instance, the API will return HTTP status code `400 Bad Request`.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Entity tag for optimistic concurrency control

Location.description: The URL of the created or updated tenant

204.description: No Content. Indicates that there is nothing to update for the existing tenant.

Location.description: The URL of the target tenant

delete.description: Deletes a tenant instance. Users can delete multiple tenants in parallel by sending multiple requests at the same time. URL of the tenant instance being deleted will be returned via HTTP header `Location`, and users can check the status of deletion request by calling `GET {Location}`.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Entity tag for optimistic concurrency control

Location.description: The URL of the deleted tenant

scopes.Tenant.Read: Read tenants and their containers and credentials
scopes.Tenant.Manage: Read, create, update, and delete tenants and their containers and credentials

type.description: The type of the container. A container can be either 'hdi' or 'schema'

name.description: The container (schema/hdi-container) name. This name must be unique in a single tenant instance.

makeUniqueName.description: A flag indicating whether to make the container name unique by appending a numerical suffix (e.g., _1, _2, etc.). When this flag is True, container 'name' must be given. The unique name is used internally, so the original given name is returned in the response.

dataEncryption.description: Data encryption configuration. If not specified, then tenant will be created with DEDICATED_KEY

mode.description: The data encryption mode. DEDICATED_KEY is SAP generated tenant dedicated key.

permissions.description: Additional permission sets that will be assigned to the credential users. Currently accepts ["development"] only

roles.description: Database roles that will be assigned to the credential users

targetTimestamp.description: The timestamp to which the recovery should be done.

dataEncryption.description: Data encryption configuration. If not specified, then tenant will be created with DEDICATED_KEY

mode.description: The data encryption mode. DEDICATED_KEY is SAP generated tenant dedicated key.

createTimestamp.description: The timestamp of the tenant created, formatted in RFC3339 (e.g., 2021-04-23T09:18:43Z)

lastTransitionTimestamp.description: The timestamp of the last change in the `ready` status, formatted in RFC3339 (e.g., 2021-04-23T09:18:43Z)

containers.description: List of the containers, only `id` will be returned by default.

type.description: The container type. It should be hdi or schema

makeUniqueName.description: If set to true the container name will be made unique by adding a unique numerical suffix (_1, _2, etc.) to the container name

lastTransitionTimestamp.description: The timestamp of the last change in the `ready` status, formatted in RFC3339 (e.g., 2021-04-23T09:18:43Z)

credentials.description: List of the credentials, only `id` will be returned by default.

hdiUser.description: Credential username for the HDI admin user for containers of type 'hdi'

hdiPassword.description: Credential password for the HDI admin user for containers of type 'hdi'

endTimestamp.description: The timestamp of operation finished. Value is `null` if still in progress
